PhoneCall * call -- 1 originator TelephoneNumberA TelephoneNumber called originator has some PhoneCalls called call. It can have none, and there is no upper bound defined.A PhoneCall called call has A TelephoneNumber called originator. It must always have exactly, one, and can never have none. And there is an upper bound of at most one TelephoneNumber called originator.When a PhoneCall is created, its TelephoneNumber must be assigned. When a PhoneCall is deleted, its TelephoneNumber is not deleted and its list of PhoneCalls is decreased. When a TelephoneNumber is deleted, its PhoneCalls are not deleted. They are assigned to another TelephoneNumber.
